scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "uv run --project backend uvicorn --factory rabblefish.app:create_app --reload --reload-dir backend/src --app-dir backend/src --port 8000" "pnpm -C frontend dev"
scripts.test: uv run --project backend pytest backend && pnpm -C frontend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend test
scripts.lint: uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend ruff format --check backend
